title: Upper endpoint of a round-orbit envelope
statement: Let $R$ be a round contract for a $k$-tape machine, let $i$ be an index, let $c$ be a configuration, and let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. For a work-tape index $j$, define $H_j$ to be the maximum of the upper envelope values assigned by $R$ to the configurations after $r$ rounds from $c$, for $0 \le r < n$, together with the head position on tape $j$ after $n$ rounds.
hypotheses_covered: A round contract $R$ for a $k$-tape machine
